protocol: The mailer base is fixed at its task root pose above the static platform/support block with gravity disabled. Every phase start and goal articulation is loaded through Genesis, read back, and paired with the production cardboard controller's commanded plastic-rest target. No dynamics step is taken while recording, so these are exact task initialization states rather than settled free-release poses.
